newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices firm, business slow.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices firm, business slow.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were firm in very quiet conditions boosted by the recent strength of CBOT corn prices although business was quiet.

Dealers said demand was slowing with an increasing number of High Plains cattle being moved to grass pastures and off feeding rations. If not for strong corn prices, the market would probably weaken, they said.
"I think people are waiting for this thing to break but the (CBOT) board is really messing things up," one dealer in the Pacific Northwest said.
CBOT corn closed lower Tuesday but remains more than 30 cents a bushel above a month ago (on the March contract).
Dealers said business was generally restricted to a few spot loads. Business was reported in north Texas at $110.00 per ton, versus an asking price Monday of $112.00.
